presets.label: Tool failure — Stepper LIT2-1 (Austin Fab)
presets.blurb: From SC360: 51% failure risk in 48h and anomalous vibration. Its work center is ~30% of plant capacity.

presets.label: Shortage — Vision Camera Module at San Jose HQ
presets.blurb: From SC360: 5.3 days of cover against a 56-day lead time from Coherent Corp. The line is short until the next receipt.

presets.label: Supplier quality hold — TRUMPF Lasertechnik (CL-201-04)
presets.blurb: Lot CL-201-04 (Vacuum Chamber) was rejected and reached 28 systems across 6 customers. A hold on the supplier while it is contained.
